$comment: THE CATALOGUE. Single source of truth for everything the Android shell can do for a page. Everything else is generated from it: the runtime facade's action table, the gate mocks, the permission enum, the Java dispatch registry (phase 3), and the docs. Hand-writing any of those is how the two sides drift. See docs/research/apk-sdk-plan.md.

actions.summary: What the shell is and what it runs on — the one action that needs no permission, so it is also how a page proves the bridge works end to end.
